notes: Sourced from Bose Professional's own "ControlSpace EX-1280/EX-440C/EX-1280C/EX-12AEC Installation & Operation Guide" (rear-panel diagram p.13 and Technical Specifications table p.32-33), which is the manufacturer's authoritative documentation. The 12 mic/line inputs and 8 line outputs are physically presented as multiple 6-pin Euroblock terminal blocks (2 balanced channels per 6-pin block), consistent with Bose's published TDS/spec-sheet figures corroborated via B&H's listing. The 2 RJ-45 Dante ports are primary/secondary Dante (64x64) and the same ports serve general Ethernet/network control (1 Gbps) per the "Network Control" spec row - no separate third network jack appears on the rear panel diagram. AmpLink RJ-45 output is a proprietary Bose digital audio link (no standard grade scale applies; requires shielded Cat5 cable) so no eth- grade was assigned. VoIP RJ-45 (2 SIP lines) and PSTN RJ-11 are telephony/analog phone lines, not graded. USB Host Type-A port is present on hardware but explicitly documented as "for future use / not currently supported" - included for completeness. Serial (RS-232 DTE) and CC-16 (RS-485) each use a 3-pin 3.81mm Euroblock, mapped to rs232/rs485 connector ids (closest match; actual connector is a detachable terminal block, not a DB9/DE9).

ports.name: Mic/Line In 12
ports.note: 12 balanced mic/line inputs total, presented on six 6-pin 3.81mm Euroblock terminal blocks (2 channels per block); +48V phantom power selectable per input

ports.name: Line Out 8
ports.note: 8 balanced line outputs total, presented on four 6-pin 3.81mm Euroblock terminal blocks (2 channels per block)

ports.name: Control Input 5
ports.note: 5 general-purpose analog/digital control inputs on a 6-pin 3.81mm Euroblock (GPIO)

ports.name: Control Output 5
ports.note: 5 general-purpose digital control outputs on a 6-pin 3.81mm Euroblock (GPIO)

ports.name: Dante 1
ports.note: Dante primary port; 64x64 channels, also carries general network/control traffic (1 Gbps)

ports.name: AmpLink Out
ports.note: Proprietary Bose digital audio output for AmpLink-equipped amplifiers; 8 channels, <21us latency, 48kHz, requires shielded Cat5 cable. Not a standard Ethernet link so no eth- grade applies.

ports.name: VoIP
ports.note: RJ-45 VoIP port, SIP 2.0-compliant, 2 lines/2 instances per line. Telephony signaling, not a graded Ethernet data link.

ports.name: Telephone Line (PSTN)
ports.note: Closest available id; actual connector is RJ-11, 1 analog phone line, Tx/Rx. RJ-11 is not in the allowed connector list so RJ-45 chosen as nearest telecom-jack match.

ports.name: USB Device
ports.note: Micro-B USB device port for soft-codec stereo audio in/out plus HID support

ports.name: USB Host
ports.note: Type-A USB host port; present on hardware but documented by Bose as reserved for future use / not currently supported

ports.name: Serial
ports.note: 3-wire RS-232C (DTE) on a 3-pin 3.81mm Euroblock terminal block, not a DB9

ports.name: CC-16
ports.note: 3-wire RS-485 (master) on a 3-pin 3.81mm Euroblock terminal block for Bose CC-16 zone controller or third-party control interfaces
